external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Organized in 1979 to provide speech, language, and hearing services, the Cornbelt Educational Cooperative has since expanded to offer a variety of regular and Special Education services for children. The Cooperative consists of a group of school districts joined together to form an educational service unit authorized under South Dakota law.
